host.description: The target web server's hostname or IP address.

port.description: The target web server's port number.

sockets.description: Number of simultaneous sockets to use for the attack.

random_user_agents.description: Randomize user agents with each request.

verbose.description: Increase logging level for terminal output.

sleep_interval.description: Sleep time interval in seconds between each header sent. 0 means no delay.

use_proxy.description: Utilize a SOCKS5 proxy for connections.

proxy_host.description: The hostname or IP of the SOCKS5 proxy server.

proxy_port.description: The port of the SOCKS5 proxy server.
